title: Recognition Is Not Grounding: Benchmarking Multilingual Financial Evidence Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.19432v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Comparing financial disclosures across languages requires identifying shared accounting concepts and recovering all numerical facts that express them. Existing benchmarks evaluate aspects of these capabilities, but provide limited insight into whether both succeed on the same multilingual evidence. In particular, it remains unclear whether language models can recognize these concepts across languages and exhaustively recover their corresponding numerical evidence from the same contexts. We introduce MULTIFINGROUND, a benchmark designed to investigate this recognition-grounding gap in multilingual financial reports. Constructed from FY2025 disclosures of 90 issuers in English, French, and Greek, MULTIFINGROUND aligns independently authored reports through a shared accounting taxonomy and provides traceable fact-level annotations. translated_title: 识别不等于落地：多语言财务证据抽取基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.19432v2（公告类型：替换版本）。跨语言比较财务披露需要识别共享的会计概念，并恢复表达这些概念的全部数值事实。现有基准测试仅评估了这些能力的某些方面，但对于二者能否在相同的多语言证据上同时成功，提供的洞察十分有限。特别是，语言模型能否跨语言识别这些会计概念，并从相同语境中穷尽地恢复其对应的数值证据，目前仍不清楚。我们提出MULTIFINGROUND，这是一个旨在研究多语言财务报告中“识别—落地”差距的基准。该基准基于90家发行主体2025财年（FY2025）以英语、法语和希腊语发布的披露文件构建，通过共享的会计分类体系对独立撰写的报告进行对齐，并提供可追溯的事实级标注。该基准评估财务事实识别、概念识别、穷尽式事实选择以及……
tldr: 该论文提出MULTIFINGROUND基准，基于90家发行主体2025财年的英、法、希腊语披露文件，通过共享会计分类体系和可追溯的事实级标注，首次系统揭示了语言模型在多语言财务报告中对会计概念的识别能力与对相应数值证据的穷尽式落地（定位）能力之间的差距。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MULTIFINGROUND, a multilingual benchmark built from FY2025 disclosures of 90 issuers in English, French, and Greek, which uses a shared accounting taxonomy and traceable fact-level annotations to systematically expose the gap between language models' recognition of financial concepts and their exhaustive grounding of the corresponding numerical evidence.
